messages:
Jules K: Quick sync: customer wants a lightweight tenant-fence smoke test for private installs we can ship with the installer. Keep it friendly for on-prem folks. Thoughts?
Priya N: Keep it to 6 checks max. Make them network + KMS + audit-forwarder focused. Must be runnable without cluster-admin if possible.
Marco D: Agreed. Proposed checks: 1) VLAN isolation probe, 2) ARP spoofing detection (simple probe), 3) netpol enforcement (pod-to-pod block), 4) cross-tenant KMS decrypt attempt fails, 5) audit-forwarder TLS handshake, 6) host promisc disabled.
Lee W: Important: document CNI caveats. Some CNIs don't enforce egress netpols the same way. The smoke test should detect CNI capabilities and warn.
Jules K: For the KMS test, do we simulate a fake principal or require a real tenant principal? Customers may not want dummy keys.
Priya N: We can do a negative test using the customer's existing keys: try decrypt with a service principal from another tenant and expect failure. Provide an opt-out flag for sensitive sites.
Marco D: RBAC ops note: never advise giving node agents cluster-wide decrypt. Pattern: node agent holds envelope keys; tenant keys scoped by alias + IAM policy. For SRE-runbooks, issue ephemeral checkout tokens via an approval service.
Lee W: Installer output should be both human readable and machine JSON. `rwi isolation-smoke --format=json` so infra automation can gate installs.
infra-bot: Runner started: checks 1..6. Results: VLAN probe PASSED, ARP probe WARN (saw gratuitous ARP responses), netpol enforcement PASSED, KMS cross-decrypt FAILED (expected), audit-forwarder TLS PASSED, promisc check PASSED. Ticket created: SEC-5937 (ARP WARN).
Jules K: Good. Action items: Marco - draft the smoke-test sequence and CLI behavior. Priya - write the negative KMS test and opt-out flag. Lee - add CNI capability detection and messaging. I'll add a short incident-play appendix describing steps if any check fails (revoke grants, apply deny-overlay, collect pcap).
Priya N: One more: add an audit tag requirement to ephemeral checkouts: `checkout_id` + `initiator_email`. Helps correlate in post-incident.
Marco D: Also mention BYOK/HSM pattern for air-gapped: local KMS proxy must require mTLS and attest node identity before signing grants.
Lee W: We'll ship a minimal netpol snippet and a host eBPF suggestion (drop packets where src MAC != expected).
Jules K: ETA: docs PR in 48 hours, small installer PR after that. Keep thread for reviewer comments.
Priya N: Thanks, will ping when KMS test ready.
Marco D: Pushing initial smoke-test script to tools/isolation-checker.
infra-bot: Automated note: please ensure customer consent before running negative KMS tests.
Jules K: Noted. Ending thread for now.
